title: Sambahulā <or Cārika>
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū Kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2. Atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu || || 3. Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā te bhikkhū apassantī paridevamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Arati viya me-jja khāyati || bahuke disvāna vivitte āsane || te cittakathā bahussutā || ko-me Gotama-savakā gatā ti || || 4. Evaṃ vutte aññatarā devatā taṃ devataṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Magadhaṃ gatā Kosalaṃ gatā || ekacciyā pana Vajja-bhūmiyā || magā viya asaṅgacārino || aniketā viharanti bhikkhavo ti || ||
